answer.summary: All 7 InjectTargetSearchTest JSON assertions fail. The actual response has an extra content[0].target_markings field that the expected JSON lacks, and the change touches the endpoint/asset mapping and output DTOs (EndpointMapper, AssetOutput, Marked). The failure is deterministic and tied to the change, so a re-run will likely fail again. The unrelated exception traces in the log come from tests that passed.
